stories.title: Putin, Erdogan discuss Black Sea situation one-on-one — Kremlin aide
stories.summary: BISHKEK, September 1. Russian President Vladimir Putin and Turkish leader Recep Tayyip Erdogan held a one-on-one discussion on the situation around the Black Sea, Kremlin aide. Yury Ushakov told Rossiyskaya Gazeta. "As far as I know, the main topic was the situation around the Black Sea," he said. The Kremlin representative noted their one-on-one meeting lasted almost an hour and a half.
